selection: Strictly positive executed-answer gain on each held-out subset with no increase in total execution failures versus control. Confirm survivors with another seed; no automatic longer training.
hypothesis: Reduce repeated-question influence while retaining all original target variants. No synthesized pairs or targets.
cpu_requirements: Verify all index source checksums and index archive bytes
Verify best checkpoint model, optimizer state and resume step on CPU before allocating GPU
Benchmark actual continuation-seed stream and confirm full equal-size batches
limitations: Per-shard candidate sampling prevents exact global uniformity. Public best parent is exploratory; reused validation does not prove generalization. CPU evidence concerns data mechanics only.
save: Every final checkpoint and predictions in Drive; export, verify and submit every unique model output once
